title: Why CareerSense?
text: CareerSense is built to empower professionals with the tools they need to grow. From personalized CV analysis to role matching and interview preparation, we make your career development smart, simple, and AI-assisted.

section.title: Built for Ambitious Professionals
section.content: CareerSense is designed for people who want more from their career — whether you're switching paths or climbing higher, we guide you with precision.

section.title: Backed by AI & Real Data
section.content: We use the power of GPT models and proven frameworks to provide personalized and data-driven career advice tailored to you.
